<?php
function h($n,$m,$file,$line){echo 'H:',$n,':',$line,':',$m==='Only variables should be passed by reference',';';return true;}
function make(){echo 'P;';return 7;}
function later(){echo 'T;';return 9;}
function &take(&$x,$y){echo 'F:',$x,':',$y,';';$x+=1;return $x;}
set_error_handler('h',8);
$v =& take(make(),later());
echo 'R:',$v,';';$v=20;echo 'W:',$v,';';
